data.long_meaning: In Greek, Doro means 'gift of God'. This name holds deep spiritual significance in Christianity and is often given to babies born as blessings. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Doro usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Doro total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_latin.name: Dorus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of 'Doro', 'Dorus', carries the same meaning as the original Hebrew and Greek. It was a name given to children born during times of abundance and joy.

in_english.name: Doro
in_english.long_meaning: The English name 'Doro' is a direct transcription of the original Hebrew and Greek. It signifies a precious gift or present, reminding us of God's love and generosity.
